obligations.title: Real-time Streaming Speech-to-Text Pipeline
obligations.description: Continuous, low-latency speech transcription displaying interim hypotheses and finalized phrases in real-time.

obligations.title: Ambient Sound & Decibel Meter Bubble
obligations.description: Google Live Transcribe signature circular volume indicator pulsing with RMS amplitude, detecting silence vs speech vs ambient noise.

obligations.title: Two-Way Deaf Communication & Type-Back Mode
obligations.description: Type-back keyboard interface with 180-degree table-flip mode for facing hearing partners, offline TTS audio playback, and customizable quick chips.

obligations.title: Acoustic Event & Sound Classification
obligations.description: Real-time acoustic badge indicators detecting environmental events such as speech, loud noise, clapping/applause, and background music.

obligations.title: Strict Offline Airgap & Zero-Telemetry Privacy
obligations.description: Zero external HTTP/WS requests, Service Worker cache-first offline storage, and airgapped Content Security Policy ensuring zero data leakage.

obligations.title: Deaf & Hard-of-Hearing Accessibility Features
obligations.description: Screen Wake Lock API, Speech onset haptic vibration, high contrast OLED Black & Yellow themes, and 18px-64px scalable typography.

obligations.title: Secure Local History & Privacy Scrubbing
obligations.description: Client-side IndexedDB conversation log with search, text/JSON export, and one-tap instant shred/wipe.
